name: Darin LaHood

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONGRATULING WOODFORD COUNTY SHERIFF MATTHEW SMITH ON HIS RETIREMENT
statements.title: CONGRATULING WOODFORD COUNTY SHERIFF MATTHEW SMITH ON HIS RETIREMENT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to recognize Sheriff Matthew L. Smith for his more than four decades of distinguished service in law enforcement to the people of Woodford County, Illinois.
Beyond his work in law enforcement, Sheriff Smith has remained deeply involved in his community.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIFA 2026 WORLD CUP
statements.title: FIFA 2026 WORLD CUP
sentences: Over 39 days, the United States alongside Canada and Mexico, hosted 104 matches, or the equivalent of 104 Super Bowls, making it the largest sporting event in the history of our country.

I thank our law enforcement officers, first responders, and public servants who worked tirelessly to make sure the tournament was safe, secure, and ensured the World Cup finished without a single major security incident.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ACCELERATING ACCESS TO DEMENTIA AND ALZHEIMER'S PROVIDER TRAINING ACT
statements.title: ACCELERATING ACCESS TO DEMENTIA AND ALZHEIMER'S PROVIDER TRAINING ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank Chairman Guthrie and everyone involved with this piece of legislation for their leadership, and I rise today in strong support of H.R. 3747, the AADAPT Act.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to co-lead this legislation, and I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PREVENTING WASTE, FRAUD, AND ABUSE IN TANF ACT
statements.title: PREVENTING WASTE, FRAUD, AND ABUSE IN TANF ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of the Preventing Waste, Fraud, and Abuse in TANF Act.
TANF was created with a clear purpose, and I think it is important to remember this: To help families move from welfare to work, promote self-sufficiency, and support low-income parents and children.
As the chairman of the Subcommittee on Work and Welfare, I have worked for years to identify and stop the TANF fraud in the program.
Chairman Jason Smith and I sent a letter to the Government Accountability Office in 2023 requesting information on TANF's program accountability measures.
In response, the GAO issued five reports in 2025 identifying that TANF lacks numerous oversight and financial guardrails expected in public assistance programs.
More specifically, the GAO identified 37 States with 162 TANF audit findings.
They also found that States are sitting on nearly $8 billion in unspent TANF funds.
First, it finally would require improper payments reporting in TANF.

If Congress is going to provide billions of dollars each year for TANF, we have a responsibility and obligation as elected leaders to ensure that dollars are helping the families experiencing genuine financial hardship.
The Preventing Waste, Fraud, and Abuse in TANF Act will reduce fraud, restore accountability, and help preserve TANF benefits for families who truly need them.

We should all be able to agree that welfare funds should go to families who need help and not to fraudsters, wasteful spending, or people or programs that can provide for themselves without Federal assistance.
In closing, I urge my colleagues to support and help taxpayers by voting for the Preventing Waste, Fraud, and Abuse in TANF Act.
In closing, I urge my colleagues to support-- The SPEAKER pro tempore.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOSTERING THE FUTURE ACT
statements.title: FOSTERING THE FUTURE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as we celebrate National Foster Care Month, I rise in strong support of H.R. 7432, the Fostering the Future Act, a bill that would empower America's foster youth transitioning to adulthood.
As chairman of the Work and Welfare Subcommittee, one of my priorities has been to modernize the Chafee Foster Care Program, which exclusively supports foster youth as they transition to adulthood.
I thank Ranking Member Danny Davis for his lifetime of work when it comes to foster care and his legacy in this space.
The Fostering the Future Act represents the most significant reforms to Chafee since its creation in 1999.
Thirty-five percent of foster youth experience homelessness compared to just 4 percent of the general population.
This bill improves coordination between Chafee and Federal housing programs to expand access to vouchers.
A history of being in foster care should not limit potential for future success.
By passing the Fostering the Future Act, Congress can ensure that foster youth have the tools they need to achieve economic independence and long-term stability and success.
Specifically, this bill includes the Foster Youth Housing Opportunity Act, which I introduced with my Democrat colleague, Gwen Moore of Wisconsin.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING THAT SECTION 11 OF HOUSE RESOLUTION 1224 SHALL HAVE NO FORCE OR EFFECT
statements.title: PROVIDING THAT SECTION 11 OF HOUSE RESOLUTION 1224 SHALL HAVE NO FORCE OR EFFECT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the rule and the underlying bill allowing for year-round sale of E15 fuel and bringing much-needed certainty to our Nation's fuel markets.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the rule and the underlying bill, H.R. 1346.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FALLEN SERVICEMEMBERS RELIGIOUS HERITAGE RESTORATION ACT
statements.title: FALLEN SERVICEMEMBERS RELIGIOUS HERITAGE RESTORATION ACT
sentences: The last reauthorization, the Reforming Intelligence and Securing America Act, RISAA, targeted 56 reforms and meaningful changes to the FBI.

If we just look over the last year here, the strategic strike in Venezuela, the Israeli hostages who were recovered from the tunnels in Hamas, taking out Iran's nuclear capabilities and the success we have had there, the taking out of drug cartel bosses in Mexico, going back to the first administration and what happened with Soleimani and al- Baghdadi, and many other instances that we can't talk about here, all of it derived from FISA 702.
We ought to support this bill to protect America and our citizens, and I urge its adoption.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of S. 1318, the Foreign Intelligence Accountability Act, and I thank Chairman Crawford for his leadership and steadfast support for reauthorization of FISA 702.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUCCESSFUL OPERATION TO ARREST NICOLAS MADURO
statements.title: SUCCESSFUL OPERATION TO ARREST NICOLAS MADURO
sentences: Nicolas Maduro and his corrupt inner circle have been U.S. law enforcement targets for over 15 years with multiple agencies, including the U.S. Department of Justice, the DEA, and the FBI, working toward his arrest and his prosecution.

In 2020, under the first Trump administration, the United States unsealed a superseding indictment out of the Southern District of New York against Maduro and more than a dozen of his associates, along with offering a $15 million reward for his capture.

The 2020 indictment described how Maduro and his top lieutenants served as leaders of the Cartel de los Soles for over two decades and partnered with known designated foreign terrorist organizations to move, at the time, over 250 tons of cocaine through Venezuela--cocaine that was cultivated, manufactured, and moved through Venezuela.

The new indictment highlights other criminal activity directly tied to Maduro, including providing fake travel documents to facilitate drug smuggling under the guise of diplomatic cover and partnerships with the Sinaloa Cartel boss El Chapo.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Building on the tremendous success of Israel in weakening Iran and eliminating Hezbollah's terrorist leader network, Hezbollah is now at its weakest point.

In listening to what the State Department said regarding the sale of military equipment to Lebanon, this is their statement: ``This proposed sale will support the foreign policy and national security of the United States by improving the security of a partner country, [Lebanon,] that continues to be an important force for political stability and economic progress in the Middle East.'' Madam Chair, I include in the Record an article dated July 12, 2025, which shows that the current Trump administration supports military funding to the LAF.
Madam Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to this misguided amendment.

To prove that point, I will reference an article from earlier this week, from July 12 of 2025: This week the Trump administration, the State Department, and the DOD approved $100 million to go to the LAF for the Super Tucano aircraft.
Madam Chair, I oppose this misguided amendment, and I urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Is it your understanding and intent, Chairman Smith, for the purposes of this provision, vehicles shall be treated as ``acquired'' as of the date on which a written binding contract is entered into for their acquisition and a payment has been made?
Mr. Speaker, in closing, I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: By making President Trump's historic tax cuts permanent, expanding the child tax credit, removing taxes on tips and overtime pay, delivering tax relief for seniors, permanently expanding the small business deduction, and putting in place the research and development tax credit, and much more, H.R. 1 will give a vital boost to our families, workers, farmers, and businesses nationwide.
I am proud to say that this package also includes language from my bipartisan legislation, the Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act.

I have heard from constituents and local leaders across Illinois' 16th Congressional District that have expressed that a lack of available, affordable housing is one of the most significant barriers to economic success in their communities and across the country.
By expanding and improving the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit, H.R. 1 will jump-start the development and construction of affordable housing nationwide and support the needs of our growing workforce.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELECTRONIC FILING AND PAYMENT FAIRNESS ACT
statements.title: ELECTRONIC FILING AND PAYMENT FAIRNESS ACT
sentences: As the chairman articulated, under current law, if a taxpayer physically mails a payment or tax return to the IRS that is postmarked on the due date, that payment or tax return is considered timely even if it is received a week later.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, the Electronic Filing and Payment Fairness Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PANDEMIC UNEMPLOYMENT FRAUD ENFORCEMENT ACT
statements.title: PANDEMIC UNEMPLOYMENT FRAUD ENFORCEMENT ACT
sentences: This bill extends the statute of limitations for CARES Act unemployment fraud from 5 to 10 years to provide law enforcement agencies with more time to go after the fraudsters and international criminal organizations.
We cannot retroactively change criminal liability for Federal crimes.
I rise in strong support of H.R. 1156, the Pandemic Unemployment Fraud Enforcement Act.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNITED STATES-TAIWAN EXPEDITED DOUBLE-TAX RELIEF ACT
statements.title: UNITED STATES-TAIWAN EXPEDITED DOUBLE-TAX RELIEF ACT
sentences: In today's global economy, it is customary for the United States to enter into tax treaties with like-minded allies to lessen potential double-tax burdens and encourage cross-border investment.

As a member of both the Ways and Means Trade Subcommittee and our Select Committee on the Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party, I know how important our relationship with Taiwan is, both in terms of trade and national security.

This bill will open the door for us to continue to develop a strong economic partnership, especially in the technology and semiconductor sectors, and help the United States reduce our reliance on China.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of the United States- Taiwan Expedited Double-Tax Relief Act.
